payload: SI-3 TS ESLint fence-rule design spike (HIGH RISK). Design an ESLint enforcement equivalent to Go depguard for Fence-A/B/C import isolation: primitive must not import application; module must not import infrastructure; composition-root must not import domain logic. Pick Option A (eslint-plugin-boundaries/custom rule) or Option B (tsconfig path-alias + CI check) and justify. Deliver a deliberate-violation proof recipe matching Go G4 AC-4b (intentional Fence-A violation reproduces non-zero lint exit with fence name in output; reverted; never committed). Time-box 1 sprint; if exceeded, recommend Option C (documented weaker TS G4 fallback) per Risk Register. Gates G4 of pilot-4 (kinh-dich, TS) and pilot-6 (news-fetch, TS). Does NOT gate pilot-3 (stock-price, Go).
constraints: main only; L84 explicit-file staging; no --force/--no-verify/--no-gpg-sign; no git push; do not modify apps/** source in the spike (design + proof recipe only)
